_comment: Operational state for the 'Try This At Home, Kids' digest scheduled task. Not meant for manual reading like story-log.org, but safe to hand-edit (e.g. null out a last_checked to force an early re-check of a low-frequency source).

current_blog.note: George's own current blog. Self-authored posts get a very low bar for inclusion: if he did it himself and it wasn't easy/possible 1/3/5 years ago, it's IN almost by default. Full historical archive (2020-2026, 200+ posts) backfilled into story-log.org on 2026-08-25 with the clear capability-threshold matches; most posts are trail/photo/book-review content that doesn't fit the digest and was deliberately left out.

old_blog.note: George's old, mostly-inactive blog. Same monthly cadence as Usenix. Self-authored posts get the same low bar as current_blog. Checked 2026-08-25: site structure resists clean crawling (pagination-only listing, robots-disallowed on most sub-paths), and the dated posts found appear to pre-date his migration to the current blog and duplicate content already there (e.g. 2023-12-22 and 2024-03-02 posts exist on both). No genuinely new capability-threshold material found. Revisit manually if George flags something specific from this blog.
